english.title: Deficiency discovered in store of a ship / aircraft / railway vehicle returning to the UK
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the vehicle operator of

(A)_[a ship]_
(B)_[an aircraft]_
(C)_[a railway vehicle]_

which departed from the United Kingdom for a destination outside the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DESTINATION..), while carrying stores but failed to reach the destination for which it was cleared outwards and returned to a place in the United Kingdom where a deficiency was discovered in the goods, the failure

(D)_[not being due to stress of weather, mechanical defect or other unavoidable cause]_
(E)_[being due to stress of weather, mechanical defect or other unavoidable cause and the deficiency, in the opinion of the Commissioners, exceeding the quantity which might fairly have been consumed having regard to the length of time between the departure and return of the journey]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 61(7) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
vehicle operator of a ship / aircraft / railway vehicle
which has departed from the United Kingdom
for a destination outside the UK carrying stores
fail to reach the destination
for which it was cleared outwards
return to a place in the UK
where a deficiency is discovered in the goods
failure not being due to
stress of weather / mechanical defect / unavoidable cause OR
failure having been due to
stress of weather / mechanical defect / unavoidable cause
the deficiency in the opinion of the Commissioners
exceeded the quantity
which might fairly have been consumed
having regard to the length of time
between the ship / aircraft / railway vehicle departure and return

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: For offences committed on or before 30th December 2020, see offence wording document H10694 (CJS code CE79270).
